name: ci-checks-github
title: CI checks GitHub adapter
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Fetches check runs, commit statuses, and the merge endpoint. The token is an argument, never an environment read.

files.content:
/**
 * Deterministic CI checks core. No React, no CSS, no network.
 * Network access is a separate module and is not re-exported here.
 */

export type {
  AgentFixEvent,
  AgentFixPort,
} from "./ci-checks/agent-port"
export { createAgentFixPort, notifyCheckFailed } from "./ci-checks/agent-port"
export type { ApprovalGate, MergeApproval, MergeApprovalRequest } from "./ci-checks/approval"
export { alwaysAskApproval } from "./ci-checks/approval"
export type { MergeDecision } from "./ci-checks/merge"
export { decideMerge, performMerge } from "./ci-checks/merge"
export {
  checkRunStatus,
  commitStatusState,
  countPassed,
  isVercelStatus,
  mergeChecks,
  normalizeCheckRun,
  normalizeCheckRunsPayload,
  normalizeCommitStatus,
  normalizePull,
  normalizeStatusesPayload,
} from "./ci-checks/normalize"
export { collectCheckRuns, nextLink } from "./ci-checks/pages"
export type { CheckRunPage } from "./ci-checks/pages"
export { DEFAULT_POLL_MS, interpretPoll, isPrimaryRateLimit, isSecondaryRateLimit, pollRequestHeaders } from "./ci-checks/poll"
export { FALLBACK_DURATION_MS, estimateProgress, median } from "./ci-checks/progress"
export { stripSecrets } from "./ci-checks/secrets"
export type {
  CheckSource,
  CheckStatus,
  CiError,
  CiErrorCode,
  NormalizedCheck,
  NormalizedCommit,
  NormalizedPull,
  NormalizedSnapshot,
  PullState,
} from "./ci-checks/types"
export type { Sha256Hmac, WebhookResult } from "./ci-checks/webhook"
export { readWebhook, timingSafeEqualString, verifyGithubSignature } from "./ci-checks/webhook"

/**
 * Own model for a pull request and its checks.
 * Deterministic. No React, no DOM, no network.
 */

export type CheckStatus = "queued" | "running" | "passed" | "failed" | "skipped" | "cancelled"

export type CheckSource = "check-run" | "commit-status"

export type NormalizedCheck = {
  id: string
  name: string
  status: CheckStatus
  source: CheckSource
  startedAt: string | null
  completedAt: string | null
  /** Measured from timestamps when both exist. Otherwise null. */
  durationMs: number | null
  url: string | null
  description: string | null
}

export type NormalizedCommit = {
  sha: string
  message: string
  author: string
  committedAt: string | null
}

export type PullState = "open" | "closed" | "merged"

export type NormalizedPull = {
  number: number
  title: string
  state: PullState
  sha: string
  message: string
  baseRef: string
  headRef: string
  additions: number
  deletions: number
  commits: NormalizedCommit[]
}

export type NormalizedSnapshot = {
  pull: NormalizedPull
  checks: NormalizedCheck[]
  passed: number
  total: number
}

export type CiErrorCode =
  | "missing_token"
  | "unauthorized"
  | "forbidden"
  | "not_found"
  | "invalid"
  | "rate_limited"
  | "secondary_rate_limited"
  | "merge_disabled"
  | "needs_confirmation"
  | "needs_approval"
  | "merge_denied"
  | "upstream"

export type CiError = {
  code: CiErrorCode
  message: string
  retryAfterMs: number | null
}

docs: Network lives here. Pass the token from the server. Minimum permissions: checks:read, statuses:read, pull_requests:read. contents:write only when merge is enabled. The example routes are app/api/ci-checks. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite a file the host already has.
